
# Jothi Heart & Skin Clinic

Jothi Heart & Skin Clinic is a dual-specialty medical clinic in Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu, India.

We specialize in:

- Cardiology Consultation
- ECG
- Echocardiogram (ECHO)
- TMT Stress Test
- Holter Monitoring
- ABPM Monitoring
- CGM Monitoring
- Coronary Angiography
- Coronary Angioplasty

- Dermatology Consultation
- Acne Treatment
- Scar Removal
- Laser Hair Removal
- Pico Laser Treatment
- Carbon Peel
- HydraFacial
- Botox Treatment
- Microneedling
- Chemical Peel
- Tattoo Removal
- Mole Removal

- PRP Hair Treatment
- GFC Hair Therapy
- Hair Loss Treatment
